string-array.name: epitaph_neutral
string-array.item: Here rests {task_title}. There is still a way forward.
A deadline passed. The possibility remains.
This promise is waiting for a quieter morning.
Unfinished is a moment, not a name.
Some plans need a second beginning.
Time moved on; this page stayed open.
A small stone marks an unfinished thought.
The work paused here. You may return.
A place for what has not happened yet.
This task outlived its first date.
A missed hour does not erase a good intention.
The calendar closed a day, not a door.
A little silence between intention and action.
A record of a promise, kept gently.
This stone leaves room for a flower.
The next step can be smaller.
Here is something worth reconsidering.
What waited can still be welcomed back.
No verdict, only a date in the past.
This quiet marker remembers your intention.
A task at rest, with its story still open.
There is patience in a second attempt.
The path continues beyond this stone.
A pause can become a turning point.

string-array.name: epitaph_philosophical
string-array.item: Time measures a promise; it cannot measure its meaning.
Between wanting and doing lies a human life.
Tomorrow is a direction, not a place to store today.
A plan is a map drawn before the weather arrives.
What we leave unfinished also teaches us what matters.
Every ending has a margin wide enough for a note.
Attention is the water that intentions need.
The future arrives without reading our lists.
A boundary crossed can become a place to begin.
The stone is still. The person who returns is changing.
Not every delay is empty; not every pause is rest.
The promise was made by someone still learning.
A clock can count hours, but not courage.
An unfinished act is a question with an open ending.
Let the past inform the next step, not command it.
We plant intentions in a world of changing seasons.
The distance to action is sometimes one kind decision.
A date belongs to the calendar. A choice belongs to you.
The quiet here is an invitation to listen.
What remains is not always what was lost.
Even a late flower belongs to its season.
Here rests certainty about how the day would unfold.
An honest revision can be an act of care.
A promise can change shape without losing its roots.

string-array.name: epitaph_dark_humor
string-array.item: Here lies {task_title}. The calendar has declined to comment.
The deadline arrived alone. Awkward.
Postponed until further afterlife.
The reminder is now a memorial.
A very long moment of preparation.
This task took the phrase rest in peace literally.
Still loading. Eternity has good bandwidth.
The to-do list has acquired real estate.
Its last words were: after one more cup.
The deadline was firm. The plan was more flexible.
An ambitious resident of tomorrow.
The stone is at least on schedule.
A minute of silence for the estimated five minutes.
Buried under excellent intentions.
The progress bar found a comfortable spot.
The plan asked for an extension. Time did not reply.
A permanent address for a temporary delay.
The first draft is now a ghost draft.
Calendar invitation accepted by nobody.
The urgent task is enjoying the quiet.
Here rests a perfectly organized intention.
The deadline left. The tab stayed open.
A stone with surprisingly little paperwork.
There is no queue at the second-chance desk.
